result.summary: Replace the wallet's separate mapWallet and wtxOrdered containers with a single boost::multi_index_container indexed by txid and insertion order. Update wallet internals, RPC endpoints, and tests to use GetWalletTx or explicit index views instead of direct map access. Mark CWalletTx::MarkDirty const so balance cache invalidation can run on const references held by the multi-index container.
result.problem: The wallet needs transaction access both by txid and by insertion order. Maintaining two containers required wtxOrdered to store raw pointers to CWalletTx instances managed by mapWallet, necessitating manual synchronization and risking dangling pointers.
evidence: PR description: 'These are replaced by a new boost multi index which indexes on txid and insertion order, allowing us to get rid of the 2 separate containers, and holding raw pointers to CWalletTx.'
result.scope_notes: The largest file, src/wallet/wallet.cpp (+208/-180), was omitted from the diff cut. The patch adds a Boost::headers dependency to the bitcoin-wallet binary target in CMake.
result.changed_since_previous: Minor adjustments or rebase; the commit structure and overall approach are unchanged.
result.card: This PR replaces the wallet's mapWallet and wtxOrdered containers with a single boost::multi_index_container indexed by txid and insertion order. Previously, looking up transactions both by hash and by sequence required two containers, where wtxOrdered kept raw pointers into mapWallet and required manual synchronization. The refactor removes redundant container management and pointer storage across wallet components. It is an internal cleanup with no dependencies or user-facing changes.

risk.why: A defect in transaction lookup or ordering indexing could lead to missing transaction records, wrong balance reporting, or wallet state corruption.
